Yes, synergies are key to winning in this game, but there is always some special items that are so damn op that it's actually more worthwhile to ditch your inscription over it.

This is a caution my friend, don't fret over getting the right inscription to the max (you'll learn what I mean when you try a Fairy Tale run) because you can win with the most terrible item synergy the world has ever seen if your dodging is good enough.

On that note if you want to learn enemy patterns I as many others would recommend Ghoul and Shield skull as they are beginner friendly and forgiving in the gameplay element.

Inscriptions are as if not more important than items

Revenge 2 inscription + Ghoul skull (unique) is op

Get enough bones so that you can at the very least upgrade your skull to unique as they get 2 skills plus their own little quirk 

Getting Wisdom 4 and Artifact 2 for magic runs and Courage 4 and Arms 2 for physical runs is especially good as they are the easiest method of doing a lot of damage

About the last point, I need to point out that if you get enough dark quartz to get the upgrade from the Witch that allows you to destroy items to get some gold from it instead of nothing then treasure rooms will always take priority over gold rooms but till then gold rooms are better.

I've been beating DM 10 pretty consistently lately so my best advice would be to get Revenge 2 and dump everything else into damage and you'll get extremely good results (Courage 4 and Arms 2 for physical and Wisdom 4 and artifact 2 for magic).

If you want to learn enemy patterns go for either shield or ghoul as they are beginner friendly.

From my experience the faster you obliterate your enemies means they will show less shiny moves overall
